time_origin: build_started_at = first recorded build artifact of this session (2026-11-19T03:35:38Z); the ~5 minutes of specification reading before it are not included, so both first_* values are lower bounds relative to the true session start.

requests_breakdown.note: Browser subresources are excluded; this is not a network-level request count. Assets and scripts are aborted before request.

coverage.scope: bounded trial: 30 sampled product pages out of the product URLs in sitemap.xml
coverage.notes: The denominator is the number of product URLs matched by ^/\d+-\d+\.htm$ in sitemap.xml at discovery time. Covered counts sampled candidates with a processed verdict in this bounded task, not the whole catalogue; the sitemap can change between runs and is not independently audited.

build_errors.message: extract.py referenced CURRENCY without importing it from config; caught by the offline extraction check on two saved pages before any crawler run.
build_errors.fix: added the config import; re-ran the offline check successfully.

network_note: Build probes (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, two product pages, one category page) were plain curl requests spaced by 6-9 seconds from the same machine egress as the crawler. They are not part of the run counts. No proxy was configured for these probes; the harness HTTP(S)_PROXY variables were present and the browser used the platform default path.

resource.cleanup: PlaywrightCrawler.run() closed its browser pool after each run
resource.residual_check: Win32_Process query for chrome/chromium/headless_shell/playwright after both runs returned 0 rows

fix_task.type: known-defect fix: stock-state mapping plus a DOM fallback selector
fix_task.change: Fixed the known-defect stock-state handling found by run-001: only InStock/OutOfStock were mapped, so a product whose variants were PreOrder had an empty availability and a business-field missing reason. The mapping now covers InStock/LimitedAvailability/OnlineOnly, OutOfStock/SoldOut/Discontinued, PreOrder and BackOrder, and falls back to the visible .urgency[data-stockcode] stock line when the offers publish no state. In the same revision, tax_basis was moved out of missing_reasons into tax_basis_note, so quality_exceptions lists only docs/02 business fields. A defensive price-parser guard (reject ambiguous single-dot decimals in es-ES) was added while writing the contract tests.

final_package.note: The package root is the fix rerun (v2); the first bounded trial (v1) is archived under diagnostics/run-001/.

limitations: Bounded trial: 30 product pages or 10 minutes, whichever comes first; 30 pages of a 6660-URL sitemap were sampled, so this is not whole-site coverage.
The 6660-URL denominator is point-in-time (2026-11-19) and not independently audited; coverage.status=KNOWN describes the denominator, not a full crawl.

No product in the sample had a zero, negative or missing price and no variant was out of stock, so A01/A02 live evidence is negative (zero occurrences), not positive; those paths are covered by synthetic contract tests only.

Option dimension names fall back to a generic 'Talla' when the page does not expose data-size_name; 14 of the 26 option-bearing rows use that label, and 8 of them carry inch/mm width, diameter or length values rather than a shoe size. The values and their order are correct; only the dimension name is weaker than the source's own label. Reading .pi_size_selector[aria-label] is the follow-up, outside the 30-minute fix window.
tax_basis is UNKNOWN for every product because the pages do not state IVA included/excluded. It is kept in the internal record as tax_basis_note and is not counted as a business-field missing reason.
One navigation attempt per run hit a 30 s timeout and succeeded on retry (87-156 in the first smoke, 60-54181 in the fix rerun). The Crawlee retry absorbed it; no product was lost.
Asset and script requests are aborted in the browser. This is a fetch decision for a server-rendered site; a template that moved price or variants into client-side JS would break it.
Pause/resume is not implemented; Ctrl+C cancels and --resume replays a checkpoint. A normal run purges its Crawlee queue and is a new task.

Crawlee's throttling request manager wrote per-domain queue state to a repository-root storage/ directory in addition to the run-scoped storage. It contained request URLs but no page content; it was listed in diagnostics/storage-residue.json and removed after the runs. Run-scoped isolation is a follow-up.
The actual network egress was not independently measured; the harness HTTP(S)_PROXY variables were present and the browser used the platform default path.

plan_version 2026.11.19-2 artifacts were produced about ten minutes before the final defensive price-parser guard, which only rejects ambiguous inputs. All 30 rows parsed their rendered price and matched a variant, so no row took the guarded path; the guard is covered by unit tests and by offline re-extraction of three saved pages.
